questions.q: You have never been to Japan. ____ he.
questions.zh: 你從未到過日本。他也沒有。
questions.explain: nor/neither ＋ 助動詞 ＋ 主詞（也不）

questions.q: On no ____ should a person be dishonest.
questions.zh: 一個人絕不可以不誠實。
questions.explain: on no account（絕不）／否定詞在句首，後面需接倒裝句。

questions.q: Never ____ heard of such a thing.
questions.zh: 我從未聽過如此的事。
questions.explain: 原句 ＝ I have never heard...

questions.q: Rarely ____ such nonsense.
questions.zh: 我很少聽到這種荒謬的話。
questions.explain: 原句 ＝ I have rarely heard..., "Rarely"（很少）為否定詞放在句首，其後的句子要倒裝。

questions.q: ____ such a crowd of people.
questions.zh: 我很少見到這麼廣大的人群。
questions.explain: 原句 ＝ I have seldom seen such a crowd of people. Seldom 置於句首引導倒裝句。

questions.q: ____ I left the school than it began to rain.
questions.zh: 我一離開學校就開始下雨。
questions.explain: No sooner had ＋ 主詞 ＋ p.p. than...（一⋯就⋯）

questions.q: John had been working hard and ____.
questions.zh: 約翰以前一直十分努力地工作，瑪麗也是。
questions.explain: 肯定句 ＋ and ＋ so ＋ 助動詞 ＋ 主詞（也是），本題前句為過去完成式，所以助動詞用 had。

questions.q: He is going home, ____ is she.
questions.zh: 他要回家了，她也是。
questions.explain: 參考第7題說明。肯定句 ＋ and so ＋ be動詞 ＋ 主詞。

questions.q: You cannot fly, nor ____ make the distance shorter.
questions.zh: 你無法飛行，也無法使距離縮短。
questions.explain: 參考第1題說明。nor 後接倒裝句，且助動詞須用肯定形 can you。

questions.q: Not only ____, but he saw her.
questions.zh: 他不僅來了，而且還看到她。
questions.explain: Not only 在句首，後面需接倒裝句（did he come）。

questions.q: Hardly ____ started when I heard a man call my name.
questions.zh: 車子才一發動，我就聽到有人在叫我。
questions.explain:
① Hardly ＋ had 主詞 p.p. ＋ when...
② hardly 為否定副詞，置於句首其後句子要倒裝。

questions.q: John can hardly do it; ____.
questions.zh: 約翰幾乎不能做這件事，瑪麗也不能。
questions.explain: 否定句 ＋ neither/nor ＋ 助動詞 ＋ 主詞（也不），本題前句有 hardly（幾乎不）為否定詞。

questions.q: Not until the age of forty ____.
questions.zh: 直到40歲，她才結婚。
questions.explain: Not（否定副詞）置於句首時，其後句子應倒裝。

questions.q: Silence must ____ as consent.
questions.zh: 沉默未必表示同意。
questions.explain: not always（未必）表示部分否定；be read as（被認為是）。句子有助動詞 must，後面接原形動詞 be。

questions.q: Not for a moment ____ the truth of your story.
questions.zh: 他未曾一刻懷疑你故事的真實性。
questions.explain: “Not” 為否定詞放在句首，其後的句子要用倒裝。

questions.q:
Henry: I didn't go to school yesterday.
George: ____
questions.zh: Henry: 昨天我沒有上學。George: 我也沒有。
questions.explain: 參考第1題說明。否定句的附和句用 nor ＋ 助動詞 ＋ 主詞。

questions.q:
"Can you tell me where my brother is?"
"Yes, of course, ____."
questions.zh: 「你可以告訴我哥哥在哪裡嗎？」「當然可以，你哥哥來了。」
questions.explain: Here ＋ 動詞 ＋ 主詞（名詞）。主詞為一般名詞時必須倒裝。

questions.q: Least of all ____ that he owes a duty to the community in such matter.
questions.zh: 他尤其沒想到在這類事情上面，他對社會負有責任。
questions.explain: least of all（尤其不）為否定副詞片語置於句首，後面的句子須倒裝。

questions.q: He exclaimed, "____ kind man before!"
options: Never have I met with such a
Never I have met with a such
questions.zh: 他驚叫說：「我以前從未見過這麼好的人！」
questions.explain: 原式 ＝ I have never met with such a kind man before. 否定副詞 Never 置於句首倒裝。

questions.q: Little wonder ____ up their hands in dismay.
questions.zh: 難怪已有些人在此驚慌中就舉起雙手宣布失敗。
questions.explain: 因為 Little wonder... ＝ (It is) no wonder (that)...，所以本句不需用倒裝句型。

questions.q: Only when one loses friendship ____ its value.
questions.zh: 只有在失去友誼時，才會知道友誼的價值。
questions.explain:
① Only when ＋ S ＋ V ＋ 倒裝句（唯有在⋯時才⋯）
② Only by ＋ V-ing ＋ 倒裝句（唯有靠⋯才⋯）

questions.q: ____ succeed in doing anything.
options: Only by working hard we can
By only working hard we can
Only by working hard can we
By only working hard can we
questions.zh: 只有努力，我們做任何事才會成功。
questions.explain: Only ＋ 副詞片語放在句首，其後的句子要用倒裝。

questions.q: ____ they are, all these advertisements are alike in one important way.
questions.zh: 雖然廣告各有不同，但它們在某一重要方面是相似的。
questions.explain: 原句 ＝ Although they are different... 讓步倒裝用 形容詞 ＋ as ＋ S ＋ V。

questions.q: ____ can we be sure of making much progress in English.
questions.zh: 只有多練習，我們才能在英語上有很大的進步。
questions.explain: 參考第22題說明。Only by ＋ V-ing 引導倒裝句 can we be...

questions.q: Only after I had reached the supermarket ____ that I had forgotten to take my purse with me.
questions.zh: 在我抵達超級市場之後，我才意識到我忘了隨身帶錢包了。
questions.explain: only ＋ 副詞子句，其後的句子要用倒裝。

sections.title: （三）翻譯填充題
sections.instructions: 根據中文提示，在空格內填入適當的字詞

questions.q:
孩子決不允許說謊。
____ no account should children ____ allowed to ____ ____.
questions.zh: 孩子決不允許說謊。
questions.explain: On no account ＋ 倒裝句（絕不可）＝ In no way ＋ 倒裝句

questions.q:
你的作業尚有待加強。
Your homework ____ something to be ____.
questions.zh: 你的作業尚有待加強。
questions.explain:
① leave nothing to be desired（相當完美）
② leave much to be desired（很差；不佳）

questions.q:
他絕對不是欺騙朋友的人。
He is ____ person to deceive ____ friends.
questions.zh: 他絕對不是欺騙朋友的人。
questions.explain:
the last ＋ N ＋ to ＋ V ／ that ＋ S ＋ V（最不可能；最不情願）
例：This is the last work that I want to do.（我最不想做這件工作。）
例：He is the last man that I want to work with.（我最不願意跟他一起工作。）

questions.q:
他脾氣暴躁，絕不是好老師。
He has a bad ____; he is ____ ____ a good teacher.
questions.zh: 他脾氣暴躁，絕不是好老師。
questions.explain: 「絕不是」可用 far from ／ anything but ／ by no means ／ not at all 等。

questions.q:
在任何情況下病人決不允許熬夜。
____ ____ circumstances should patients ____ allowed to ____ ____ late.
questions.zh: 在任何情況下病人決不允許熬夜。
questions.explain: Under no circumstances（在任何情況下都不可⋯）；熬夜可用 stay up 或 sit up。

sections.title: （四）連貫式翻譯
sections.instructions: 將下列中文句子翻譯成英文

questions.q: 但是並非每個人都能如願地事事成功。
questions.answer: However, everyone can't succeed in doing everything as he wishes to.
questions.zh: 但是並非每個人都能如願地事事成功。
questions.explain: every... not... ＝ not every...（並非每個都⋯）

questions.q: 不論貧富我們不可用不當的手段去做事。
questions.answer: Whether we are rich or poor, we shouldn't do things in dishonest ways.
questions.zh: 不論貧富我們不可用不當的手段去做事。
questions.explain: whether A or B: 不論 A 或是 B

questions.q: 畢竟，成功不是靠運氣而是靠努力獲得的。
answer: It is because success does not depend on good luck but on hard work.
It is because success depends not so much on good luck as on hard work.
questions.zh: 畢竟，成功不是靠運氣而是靠努力獲得的。
questions.explain:
① 本句亦可用：It is because success depends not so much on good luck as on hard work.
② not so much A as B:（與其說 A 不如說 B）

questions.q: 唯有靠不斷地努力我們才能實現自己的夢想。
questions.answer: Only by working hard constantly can we make our dreams come true.
questions.zh: 唯有靠不斷地努力我們才能實現自己的夢想。
questions.explain:
①（夢想）實現：come true
②（人）實現（夢想）：fulfill, realize

sections.title: （五）選答案測驗
sections.instructions:
閱讀短文，並選出空格內最適當的答案：

In the early 1800's there was a businessman in New York __1.__ Sam Wilson. He was __2.__ that people called him Uncle Sam. He sold meat to the Army. Uncle Sam always wrote U. S. on the boxes. The soldiers were not sure __3.__ U. S. meant United States or Uncle Sam, so the soldiers said that they were eating Uncle Sam's meat. Soon, people began calling the __4.__ Uncle Sam, and there were cartoons of him in the newspapers. His picture became __5.__.
During World War I there was a famous poster __6.__ a picture of Uncle Sam. Uncle Sam pointed his __7.__ and said, "I WANT YOU FOR THE U. S. ARMY." This poster was very popular. It __8.__ today.
Many people had forgotten that __9.__ an Uncle Sam Wilson, so in 1961 Congress officially said that the name "Uncle Sam" __10.__ Samuel Wilson.

【詞彙與片語提示】
1. businessman: 商人
2. Army: 軍隊
3. meant: 動：意思是⋯；指⋯
4. cartoons: 名：卡通
5. poster: 名：海報
6. pointed: 動：指著⋯
7. popular: 形：受歡迎
8. Congress: 名：國會
9. officially: 副：正式地
10. had forgotten: 已經忘記

questions.q: In the early 1800's there was a businessman in New York ____ Sam Wilson.
questions.zh: 十九世紀初，紐約有一位名叫山姆・威爾遜的商人。
questions.explain: 原句 ＝ ... a businessman... 〔who was named...〕 ＝ ... a businessman... 〔named...〕

questions.q: He was ____ that people called him Uncle Sam.
questions.zh: 他是如此友善，以致於大家都叫他山姆大叔。
questions.explain:
① so friendly that...（如此友善以致於⋯）
② 若用 funny，則為 so funny that...

questions.q: The soldiers were not sure ____ U. S. meant United States or Uncle Sam, so the soldiers said that they were eating Uncle Sam's meat.
questions.zh: 士兵們不確定 U. S. 是指美國還是山姆大叔，因此士兵們說他們在吃山姆大叔的肉。
questions.explain:
① whether A or B（A 或是 B）
② as if ＝ as though（好像）；even if ＝ even though（即使）

questions.q: Soon, people began calling the ____ Uncle Sam, and there were cartoons of him in the newspapers.
questions.zh: 不久，人們開始把政府稱為山姆大叔，報紙上也出現了他的漫畫。
questions.explain: (A) 政府  (B) 商人  (C) 軍人  (D) 卡通

questions.q: His picture became ____.
questions.zh: 他的畫像變得大受歡迎。
questions.explain: (A) 遺忘的  (B) 注意的  (C) 受歡迎的  (D) 生動的

questions.q: During World War I there was a famous poster ____ a picture of Uncle Sam.
questions.zh: 第一次世界大戰期間，有一張印有山姆大叔肖像的著名海報。
questions.explain: with 表示「有」，亦可用 having 或 which had。

questions.q: Uncle Sam pointed his ____ and said, "I WANT YOU FOR THE U. S. ARMY."
questions.zh: 山姆大叔指著他的手指說：「美軍需要你。」
questions.explain: (A) 海報  (B) 圖片  (C) 手指  (D) 身材

questions.q: This poster was very popular. It ____ today.
questions.zh: 這張海報非常受歡迎。它今天仍被使用。
questions.explain: 物 ＋ be used（物被使用），此處用被動語態 is still used。

questions.q: Many people had forgotten that ____ an Uncle Sam Wilson, so in 1961 Congress officially said that the name "Uncle Sam" (10) Samuel Wilson.
questions.zh: 許多人已經忘記過去真的有一位山姆・威爾遜大叔。
questions.explain:
① there really was（真的有⋯）
② 表示「過去有」用 there was。

questions.q: Many people had forgotten that (9) an Uncle Sam Wilson, so in 1961 Congress officially said that the name "Uncle Sam" ____ Samuel Wilson.
questions.zh: 所以 1961 年國會正式認定「山姆大叔」這個名字源自於山繆・威爾遜。
questions.explain: had come from（來自於、源自於），此處用過去完成式表達在 1961 年宣布之前就已發生的由來。
